activation_equation: J_A = k_act * q(C) * g_harvest * N * F; dA/dt += J_A and dW/dt += J_A
activation_inputs: D-096 function gain or active template/network/composition gain
post_phase1_extensions: DC-DEV-017 observer evidence and phase gate calculations
prior_art_disposition: REFERENCE: primary literature only; COMPOSE: demand/homeostasis principle; BUILD: bounded Digital Cell assay adapter; REJECT: external code and unqualified biological parameters
sealed_values: certified Phase-1 equations and chemistry-core source
sink_equations: A decay = k_a_decay * starve(N*F) * A * dt
structural A use = min(structural_build_flux * dt / yield, A * area)
membrane A use = min(0.02 * q(C) * g_build * A * perimeter * dt, A * area, room)
source_sink_units: N,F,A,R,C,L,M,W are concentration or material ledgers as implemented; area multiplication converts concentration flux to material ledger units
